verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Scheduled Rollouts, a manual emergency disable switch, and Infra Analytics alerts that "catch regressions". None of these documents a rollout guarded by metrics that rolls back on its own when a regression is detected. Pairing separate alerts with a manual kill switch is a user-side arrangement, and Autotune's bandit traffic shifting is a different capability, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can guard a rollout with metrics so a regression is detected and the release is rolled back automatically
